audience.text: Rust developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx files without relying on Microsoft Office or Aspose.Cells Enterprise Edition.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks or load existing .xlsx files from paths, byte arrays, or streams with optional repair and diagnostics.
capabilities.title: Create and load workbooks

capabilities.text: Write and read typed cell values including strings, integers, booleans, decimals, and dates using CellMut and Cell APIs.
capabilities.title: Typed cell value handling

capabilities.text: Enter formulas with precomputed cached results using CellMut::put_formula_with_cached_value and retrieve formatted display values.
capabilities.title: Formula support with cached values

capabilities.text: Apply comprehensive cell styling including fonts, fills, borders, number formats, alignment, and text wrapping via CellStyle and StyleFlag.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Apply conditional formatting rules (cell-value, expression, color-scale, data-bar, icon-set) and enforce data validation constraints.
capabilities.title: Conditional formatting and validation

capabilities.text: Manage worksheets, rows, columns, merged areas, freeze panes, auto-filters, and page setup including margins, orientation, and page breaks.
capabilities.title: Worksheet structure management

capabilities.text: Embed charts (column, line, bar, pie, scatter, radar, bubble, stock), pictures, and drawing shapes (rectangles, stars, arrows) on worksheets.
capabilities.title: Charts, pictures, and shapes

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended document properties, defined names, comments, hyperlinks, and sparkline groups.
capabilities.title: Document properties and metadata

limitations.text: Supports only .xlsx (OOXML/SpreadsheetML) format; does not handle legacy .xls (BIFF), ODS, or CSV formats.
No automated test suite is included; cargo test reports 0 tests.
Not yet published to crates.io; must be used as a Git or path dependency.
The public API surface is not a complete match for Aspose.Cells Enterprise Edition; some features are partial or evolving.
A workbook must retain at least one worksheet; removing the last worksheet returns CellsError::Unsupported.

problems_solved.text: Enables pure-Rust processing of Excel .xlsx files without requiring Microsoft Office installation or Aspose.Cells proprietary runtime.
Provides typed cell value handling, formula support with cached results, and comprehensive styling capabilities for programmatic spreadsheet generation and modification.
Supports defensive loading of corrupted or malformed XLSX files via LoadOptions repair flags and structured diagnostics reporting.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a pure-Rust library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without external dependencies or proprietary runtimes.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported chart types and their rendering fidelity is not fully specified beyond the listed families.
Whether all public symbols listed in the fact dossier are fully implemented and tested is unclear due to absence of automated tests.
The scope of formula calculation support beyond cached values is not detailed.
Whether external link resolution and calculation is supported is not evident from the available facts.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook with Workbook::new(), write typed values and formulas to cells, and save to .xlsx using Workbook::save_xlsx().

workflows.name: Load and inspect workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file using Workbook::load_xlsx() or from bytes/stream variants, inspect load diagnostics for issues, and access worksheets and cells.

workflows.name: Apply styling and formatting
workflows.text: Modify cell styles using CellStyle with Font, Fill, and Borders; apply number formats, alignment, and conditional formatting rules.

workflows.name: Manage worksheet structure
workflows.text: Add, rename, hide, or remove worksheets; configure page setup, freeze panes, auto-filters, and data validation rules.

workflows.name: Embed charts and shapes
workflows.text: Add charts, pictures, and drawing shapes to worksheets using ChartCollection, PictureCollection, and ShapeCollection.
